verdict.rationale: Undermind runs a deep search that returns a ranked, relevance-filtered list of papers (docs-4, docs-16), which acts as a form of screening. It also reads full-text PDFs in parallel to answer the same specific questions across many papers, including from figures and tables (docs-5), which approximates consistent extraction. Hands-on users report missed gray literature and irrelevant results mixed in (comm-4, comm-5), so screening completeness is imperfect. Missing for 10: explicit user-defined inclusion/exclusion screening criteria, a structured or tabular extraction schema applied uniformly across papers, and audit or reproducibility evidence for the screening decisions.
